items.prompt: For Q=23,n=7, what constrains all seven scheduled quantities?

options.text: They can differ by up to the remainder 2.
options.why: The two extras go to different buckets, not one two-unit increment.
Integer shares require distributing the remainder rather than fractional outputs.

options.text: Each is 3 or 4, so maximum minus minimum is 1.
options.why: 23=7*3+2; two buckets receive 4 and the other five receive 3.

options.text: The last bucket alone must receive 5.
options.why: Neither the magnitude nor the late tie choice follows the declared construction.
